pass_a_gloss: If Jesus prays not vainly — obtaining by prayer what without it perhaps not — who neglects prayer? (Mark 1:35; Luke 11:1; 6:12; John 17:1; 11:42: always praying, always heard.) Catalogue of the heard: Hannah→Samuel (after Moses); Hezekiah→Savior's forefathers; Mordecai/Esther→Purim (Mordecai-day beside Moses'); Judith→Holofernes shamed; youths→dew, no fire-smell (Dan 3); Daniel→muzzled lions; Jonah→belly heard, Ninevites lack filled. Thanksgiving applications: barren souls bearing saving words; enemies dissolved (Ps 19:8 LXX; 32:17 LXX); opposing commander cut down, Judith (= confession) growing; fire/muzzled lions/death-belly survived (Dan 3:27; Isa 25:8). Anagoge program: not small/earthly things but mystic, types expounded — train unbarren, hear spiritually (Hannah/Hezekiah heard; Mordecai/Esther/Judith saved from intelligible foes); Egypt-iron-furnace escapees thank like furnace-kept-unwet; beasts/asp unharmed hymn the Rescuer (Ps 73:19; 90:13 LXX). Jonah's type for examiners (Job 3:3; Leviathan tamed; repent-obey-prophesy without begrudging); Samuel's voices-and-rain possible now (1 Sam 12:16-18); harvest saints hear (John 4:35-36); Spirit-adorned callers get voices/soul-rain; Elijah shut/opened heaven 3.5 years (Jas 5:17) — every pray-er gets soul-rain.
